section_path_text: MMI Daily Iron Ore Index Report August 25 2026
summary:
Main
Today, the DCE iron ore futures consolidated on a subdued note. The most-traded I2701 contract on DCE closed at 713.5 yuan/mt, down 0.28%from the previous trading day. Spot prices at Qingdao port fell by 0-2 yuan/mt, traders sold at market prices, and steel mills restocked as needed.
